examples.en: The office is at sixes and sevens.
examples.zh: 辦公室亂成一團。

examples.en: The wedding plans were at sixes and sevens.
examples.zh: 婚禮安排一片混亂。

meaning.en: ; what is happening; what they should do; who is responsible; which plan or instruction to follow; how something should be organised.
meaning.zh: 處於混亂、無組織或無所適從的狀態，尤其是人們不知道：
naturalZh: 處於混亂、無組織或無所適從的狀態，尤其是人們不知道：

register.summaryEn: At sixes and sevens is informal and especially associated with British English. Cambridge notes that it can sound old-fashioned in American English, while Collins labels it informal and mainly British.
register.summaryZh: at sixes and sevens 屬於非正式表達，尤其常與英式英語聯繫。 它在美式英語中可能顯得較舊式，但在英式對話、一般文章、新聞評論和故事中仍然容易理解。
register.formalEn: In a highly formal report, clearer alternatives may include:
register.formalZh: at sixes and sevens 屬於非正式表達，尤其常與英式英語聯繫。 它在美式英語中可能顯得較舊式，但在英式對話、一般文章、新聞評論和故事中仍然容易理解。

fixedVariable.fixedEn: Keep the fixed words and word order shown in the source expression.
fixedVariable.fixedZh: 保留原檔目標表達中的固定字詞及字序。
fixedVariable.variableEn: Change only the verb form, possessive, tense or surrounding grammar permitted by the source patterns.
fixedVariable.variableZh: 只按照原檔句式改變動詞形式、所有格、時態或前後文法。

forms.form: Subject + be + at sixes and sevens.
forms.example: The office is at sixes and sevens.

forms.form: Subject + may / might / could / will + be + at sixes and sevens.
forms.example: The team may be at sixes and sevens for several days.

forms.form: Subject + remain + at sixes and sevens.
forms.example: The office remained at sixes and sevens all morning.

forms.form: Subject + seem / seems / seemed + to be + at sixes and sevens.
forms.example: The project team seems to be at sixes and sevens.

forms.form: Subject + end up / ended up + at sixes and sevens.
forms.example: Without a clear plan, the volunteers could end up at sixes and sevens.

forms.form: Cause + leave + person, group, place or plan + at sixes and sevens.
forms.example: The sudden change left everyone at sixes and sevens.

forms.form: Subject + find + oneself / object + at sixes and sevens.
forms.example: The students found themselves at sixes and sevens.

forms.form: With + noun + at sixes and sevens, + main clause.
forms.example: With the timetable at sixes and sevens, several pupils went to the wrong rooms.

forms.form: At sixes and sevens + optional information, + subject + verb.
forms.example: At sixes and sevens after the power cut, the staff did not know which orders had been sent.

forms.form: Be + subject + at sixes and sevens?
forms.example: Are the arrangements still at sixes and sevens?

forms.form: Subject + reporting verb + that + subject + be + at sixes and sevens.
forms.example: The director admitted that the department was at sixes and sevens.

specificForms.titleZh: 句式一：放在 be 之後
specificForms.formula: Subject + be + at sixes and sevens.
specificForms.descriptionEn: This is the most familiar and important grammar frame.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 這是最常見和最重要的句式。

examples.en: The office is at sixes and sevens.
examples.zh: 辦公室亂成一團。

examples.en: The wedding plans were at sixes and sevens.
examples.zh: 婚禮安排一片混亂。

examples.en: Everyone has been at sixes and sevens since Monday.
examples.zh: 自星期一起，所有人都一直無所適從。

specificForms.titleZh: 句式二：情態動詞加 be
specificForms.formula: Subject + may / might / could / will + be + at sixes and sevens.
specificForms.descriptionEn: The modal verb expresses possibility, prediction or uncertainty. It is not part of the fixed expression.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 情態動詞表示可能性、預測或不確定程度，並不是固定表達的一部分。

examples.en: The team may be at sixes and sevens for several days.
examples.zh: 團隊可能會一連數天陷入混亂。

examples.en: Without a leader, the office could be at sixes and sevens.
examples.zh: 沒有領導，辦公室可能會亂成一團。

examples.en: The plans will be at sixes and sevens unless someone takes control.
examples.zh: 除非有人接手處理，否則計劃將會一片混亂。

specificForms.titleZh: 句式三：放在 remain 之後
specificForms.formula: Subject + remain + at sixes and sevens.
specificForms.descriptionEn: Remain emphasises that the confusion continues.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 強調混亂的狀態持續不變。

examples.en: The office remained at sixes and sevens all morning.
examples.zh: 辦公室整個早上仍然一片混亂。

examples.en: The arrangements may remain at sixes and sevens until Friday.
examples.zh: 有關安排可能要到星期五前仍然十分混亂。

specificForms.titleZh: 句式四：放在 seem to be 之後
specificForms.formula: Subject + seem / seems / seemed + to be + at sixes and sevens.
specificForms.descriptionEn: Source grammar frame: Subject + seem / seems / seemed + to be + at sixes and sevens.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 原檔列出的句法框架：Subject + seem / seems / seemed + to be + at sixes and sevens。

examples.en: The project team seems to be at sixes and sevens.
examples.zh: 項目團隊看來十分混亂。

examples.en: The organisers seemed to be at sixes and sevens over the timetable.
examples.zh: 主辦人看來對時間表毫無頭緒。

specificForms.titleZh: 句式五：放在 end up 之後
specificForms.formula: Subject + end up / ended up + at sixes and sevens.
specificForms.descriptionEn: End up describes the final and usually unwanted result.
specificForms.descriptionZh: end up 表示最後出現的結果，而這個結果通常並非人們所期望。

examples.en: Without a clear plan, the volunteers could end up at sixes and sevens.
examples.zh: 沒有清晰計劃，義工最終可能會亂成一團。

examples.en: The repair team ended up at sixes and sevens after receiving two different plans.
examples.zh: 維修團隊收到兩套不同計劃後，最終陷入一片混亂。

specificForms.titleZh: 句式六：leave 加受詞的結果句式
specificForms.formula: Cause + leave + person, group, place or plan + at sixes and sevens.
specificForms.descriptionEn: Here, at sixes and sevens describes the resulting state of the object.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 在這個句式中，at sixes and sevens 描述受詞最後陷入的狀態。

examples.en: The sudden change left everyone at sixes and sevens.
examples.zh: 突然的改動令所有人無所適從。

examples.en: The unclear instructions left the whole office at sixes and sevens.
examples.zh: 不清晰的指示令整間辦公室亂成一團。

examples.en: The new timetable has left the pupils at sixes and sevens.
examples.zh: 新時間表令學生全都不知所措。

specificForms.titleZh: 句式七：放在 find 之後
specificForms.formula: Subject + find + oneself / object + at sixes and sevens.
specificForms.descriptionEn: This structure describes what somebody discovers about a situation.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 這個句式描述某人發現自己或某個地方正處於甚麼狀態。

examples.en: The students found themselves at sixes and sevens.
examples.zh: 學生發現自己完全無所適從。

examples.en: The manager returned to find the shop at sixes and sevens.
examples.zh: 經理回來時發現店舖亂成一團。

specificForms.titleZh: 句式八：with 加名詞的句式
specificForms.formula: With + noun + at sixes and sevens, + main clause.
specificForms.descriptionEn: The with phrase supplies the background or reason for the main event.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 短語提供主要事件的背景或原因。

examples.en: With the timetable at sixes and sevens, several pupils went to the wrong rooms.
examples.zh: 由於時間表混亂，有幾名學生去了錯誤的課室。

examples.en: With everyone at sixes and sevens, the manager called a short meeting.
examples.zh: 由於所有人都無所適從，經理召開了一次短會議。

specificForms.formula: At sixes and sevens + optional information, + subject + verb.
specificForms.descriptionEn: This is a later-stage structure. The person or group described by the opening phrase must be clear.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 這是較後階段的句式。 句首短語所描述的人或團體必須十分清楚。

examples.en: At sixes and sevens after the power cut, the staff did not know which orders had been sent.
examples.zh: 停電後員工一片混亂，不知道哪些訂單已經寄出。

examples.en: At sixes and sevens over the guest list, the family could not send the invitations.
examples.zh: 這個家庭對賓客名單毫無頭緒，因此無法發出邀請。

specificForms.formula: Be + subject + at sixes and sevens?
specificForms.descriptionEn: Source grammar frame: Be + subject + at sixes and sevens?.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 原檔列出的句法框架：Be + subject + at sixes and sevens?。

examples.en: Are the arrangements still at sixes and sevens?
examples.zh: 有關安排是否仍然十分混亂？

examples.en: Why is everyone at sixes and sevens?
examples.zh: 為甚麼所有人都無所適從？

examples.en: What left the whole team at sixes and sevens?
examples.zh: 甚麼事情令整個團隊陷入混亂？

specificForms.titleZh: 句式十一：嵌入及轉述子句
specificForms.formula: Subject + reporting verb + that + subject + be + at sixes and sevens.
specificForms.descriptionEn: The target can therefore appear inside a longer sentence rather than always occupying the final position.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 因此，目標表達可以出現在較長句子的中間，並不需要每次都放在整句末尾。

examples.en: The director admitted that the department was at sixes and sevens.
examples.zh: 總監承認部門當時亂成一團。

examples.en: The report said that the team had been left at sixes and sevens.
examples.zh: 報告表示，團隊被弄得無所適從。

benefits.titleEn: It Summarises Several Forms of Confusion
benefits.en: Everyone was at sixes and sevens.
benefits.zh: 較長的句子需要逐一說明人們不知道發生甚麼事、誰人負責和下一步應做甚麼； 慣用語可以把這些意思簡潔地概括起來。

benefits.en: It can therefore describe both confused people and badly organised situations.
benefits.zh: 新員工全都無所適從。 活動計劃一片混亂。 因此，它既可以描述感到混亂的人，也可以描述組織欠佳的情況。

examples.en: The new workers were at sixes and sevens.
examples.zh: 新員工全都無所適從。

examples.en: The event plans were at sixes and sevens.
examples.zh: 活動計劃一片混亂。

benefits.titleEn: It Connects a Cause with Its Result
benefits.en: This sentence clearly connects the unclear message with the confusion that followed.
benefits.zh: 這個句子清楚連繫不清晰的訊息和隨後出現的混亂。

benefits.en: The expression can indirectly suggest that leadership, instructions or planning have been inadequate.
benefits.zh: 這個表達可以間接指出領導、指示或規劃存在不足。

benefits.titleEn: It Adds Character to Informal British English
benefits.en: The idiom gives the sentence a more colourful and conversational quality than simply saying confused or disorganised. However, it is not automatically better than plain English. In formal or international communication, confused or poorly organised may sometimes be clearer.
benefits.zh: 與直接使用 confused 或 disorganised 相比，這個慣用語令句子更具畫面和口語特色。 不過，它並不一定比直接的英語更好。 在正式或國際溝通中，confused 或 poorly organised 有時會更加清晰。

origin.statusEn: Most Likely Origin: Medieval Dice Language and Gradual Development
origin.statusZh: 最可能的來源：中世紀擲骰子用語及逐漸演變

history.en: 1. taking a reckless risk; 2. leaving matters unsettled; 3. creating disorder; 4. being in confusion or disorder.
history.zh: 這個表達大致經歷了以下意思演變：

origin.memoryEn: The numbers no longer describe an actual calculation. Think of them as representing a situation in which everything has become mixed up and nobody knows the correct order.
origin.memoryZh: 這些數字已不再表示真正的計算。可以把它們想像成所有事情次序大亂，沒有人知道正確安排的情況。

rules.titleZh: 規則一：保留全部四個字
rules.en: The preposition at is an essential part of the idiom.
rules.zh: 介詞 at 是這個慣用語不可缺少的部分。

rules.titleZh: 規則二：不可改變數字形式
rules.en: The plural forms sixes and sevens are fixed.
rules.zh: 複數形式 sixes 和 sevens 都是固定部分。

rules.titleZh: 規則三：加入正確的連繫動詞
rules.en: At sixes and sevens is not normally a complete sentence by itself.
rules.zh: 本身通常不能構成完整句子。

rules.titleEn: Make the Verb Agree with the Subject
rules.titleZh: 規則四：動詞必須與主語一致
rules.en: Make the Verb Agree with the Subject

rules.titleEn: Keep Optional Information Outside the Target
rules.titleZh: 規則五：補充資訊放在固定表達之外
rules.en: Over, after, because and since provide additional information. They are not part of the idiom.
rules.zh: over、after、because 和 since 提供額外資訊，但並不是慣用語的一部分。

rules.titleEn: Use “Over” for the Matter Causing Confusion
rules.titleZh: 規則六：使用 over 指出令人困惑的事項
rules.en: Use “Over” for the Matter Causing Confusion
rules.zh: 這個家庭對搬屋日期感到十分混亂。

rules.titleEn: Do Not Use It for One Small Mistake
rules.titleZh: 規則七：不要用於一個小錯誤
rules.en: I received three different dates and did not know which one was correct, so I was at sixes and sevens.
rules.zh: 如果只是一個小錯誤，通常不需要使用這個慣用語。 它較適合描述較全面或持續的混亂。

rules.titleEn: Do Not Confuse Disorder with Disagreement
rules.titleZh: 規則八：不要混淆「混亂」和「意見不合」
rules.en: The team does not know what to do. The two teams strongly disagree with each other.
rules.zh: 團隊不知道應做甚麼。 兩隊彼此嚴重意見不合。

rules.titleEn: Do Not Interpret the Numbers Literally
rules.titleZh: 規則九：不要按字面解讀數字
rules.en: at six or seven o’clock; in groups of six and seven; between the numbers six and seven; receiving marks of six and seven.
rules.zh: 這個表達與六時或七時、六人或七人一組、數字六和七之間，以及取得六分或七分都沒有關係。

rules.titleZh: 規則十：保留時態及情態
rules.en: Do not change may be into was. That would change a possibility into a past fact.
rules.zh: 不要把 may be 改為 was，否則會把可能情況改成過去的事實。

rules.titleEn: Keep the Cause When It Matters
rules.titleZh: 規則十一：保留重要原因
rules.en: The cause is an independent part of the message and should normally remain.
rules.zh: 原因屬於句子的獨立重要資訊，因此通常應該保留。

rules.titleZh: 規則十二：不要重複相同意思
rules.en: At sixes and sevens already communicates the general state of confusion. Do not immediately add another clause that merely repeats the same meaning.
rules.zh: 已經表達整體混亂，因此不要立即加入另一個只是重複相同意思的子句。

instructions.en: Rewrite or respond using the target idiom.
instructions.zh: 使用目標慣用語改寫句子或完成回應。

questions.prompt: After the manager left suddenly, nobody in the office knew who was responsible for each job.
questions.promptZh: 經理突然離職後，辦公室裡沒有人知道每項工作應由誰負責。
questions.answer: After the manager left suddenly, the office was at sixes and sevens.
questions.answerZh: 經理突然離職後，辦公室亂成一團。
questions.targetMeaning: ● what is happening; ● what they should do; ● who is responsible; ● which plan or instruction to follow; ● how something should be organised.

questions.prompt: The meeting time changed twice, and everyone became confused about when to arrive.
questions.promptZh: 會議時間改了兩次，大家都不清楚應該何時到達。
questions.answer: Everyone was at sixes and sevens after the meeting time changed twice.
questions.answerZh: 會議時間改了兩次後，大家都無所適從。
questions.targetMeaning: ● what is happening; ● what they should do; ● who is responsible; ● which plan or instruction to follow; ● how something should be organised.

questions.prompt: Our flight was cancelled, so we no longer knew where to stay or how to continue the journey.
questions.promptZh: 航班取消後，我們不知道應該住在哪裡，也不知道如何繼續行程。
questions.answer: After the flight was cancelled, our travel plans were at sixes and sevens.
questions.answerZh: 航班取消後，我們的旅行計劃變得一片混亂。
questions.targetMeaning: ● what is happening; ● what they should do; ● who is responsible; ● which plan or instruction to follow; ● how something should be organised.

questions.prompt: On the morning of the wedding, the food was late, the flowers were missing, and nobody knew where the rings were.
questions.promptZh: 婚禮當天早上，食物遲遲未到，鮮花不見了，也沒有人知道戒指放在哪裡。
questions.answer: On the morning of the wedding, the whole house was at sixes and sevens.
questions.answerZh: 婚禮當天早上，整間屋都亂成一團。
questions.targetMeaning: ● what is happening; ● what they should do; ● who is responsible; ● which plan or instruction to follow; ● how something should be organised.

questions.prompt: Nobody had explained my new job, so I did not know what to do first.
questions.promptZh: 沒有人向我解釋新工作，所以我不知道應該先做甚麼。
questions.answer: I was at sixes and sevens because nobody had explained my new job.
questions.answerZh: 由於沒有人向我解釋新工作，我完全不知所措。
questions.targetMeaning: ● what is happening; ● what they should do; ● who is responsible; ● which plan or instruction to follow; ● how something should be organised.

questions.prompt: Three teachers became ill, and the school no longer knew which classes should go to which rooms.
questions.promptZh: 三名教師生病後，學校不知道各班應到哪一個課室上課。
questions.answer: After three teachers became ill, the school timetable was at sixes and sevens.
questions.answerZh: 三名教師生病後，學校時間表亂成一團。
questions.targetMeaning: ● what is happening; ● what they should do; ● who is responsible; ● which plan or instruction to follow; ● how something should be organised.

questions.prompt: Since its leader resigned, the team has not known who should make decisions.
questions.promptZh: 自隊長辭職後，團隊一直不知道應由誰作決定。
questions.answer: Since its leader resigned, the team has been at sixes and sevens.
questions.answerZh: 自隊長辭職後，團隊一直無所適從。
questions.targetMeaning: ● what is happening; ● what they should do; ● who is responsible; ● which plan or instruction to follow; ● how something should be organised.

questions.prompt: The moving company changed the date, and for several days the family did not know when to pack or leave.
questions.promptZh: 搬運公司更改了日期，令這個家庭一連數天都不知道應何時收拾和搬走。
questions.answer: For several days after the company changed the date, their moving plans were at sixes and sevens.
questions.answerZh: 搬運公司更改日期後，他們的搬屋安排一連數天都十分混亂。
questions.targetMeaning: ● what is happening; ● what they should do; ● who is responsible; ● which plan or instruction to follow; ● how something should be organised.

questions.prompt: We had no clear idea who should welcome the guests, prepare the room or check the food.
questions.promptZh: 我們完全不知道應由誰接待賓客、準備場地和檢查食物。
questions.answer: We were at sixes and sevens over who should do each task.
questions.answerZh: 我們對每項工作應由誰負責仍然毫無頭緒。
questions.targetMeaning: ● what is happening; ● what they should do; ● who is responsible; ● which plan or instruction to follow; ● how something should be organised.

questions.prompt: During our first week in the new office, the computers did not work, the boxes had no labels, and none of us knew where anything was.
questions.promptZh: 搬進新辦公室的第一星期，電腦不能使用，箱子又沒有標籤，沒有人知道物品放在哪裡。
questions.answer: We were all at sixes and sevens during our first week in the new office.
questions.answerZh: 搬進新辦公室的第一星期，我們全都手忙腳亂。
questions.targetMeaning: ● what is happening; ● what they should do; ● who is responsible; ● which plan or instruction to follow; ● how something should be organised.

questions.prompt: The office may remain badly organised until a new manager arrives.
questions.promptZh: 在新經理到任前，辦公室可能會繼續處於混亂狀態。
questions.answer: Until a new manager arrives, the office may remain at sixes and sevens.
questions.answerZh: 在新經理到任前，辦公室可能仍會一片混亂。
questions.targetMeaning: ● what is happening; ● what they should do; ● who is responsible; ● which plan or instruction to follow; ● how something should be organised.

questions.prompt: If the volunteers begin without a clear plan, they may become confused and badly organised.
questions.promptZh: 如果義工在沒有清晰計劃的情況下開始工作，他們可能會變得混亂，不知道應做甚麼。
questions.answer: Without a clear plan, the volunteers could end up at sixes and sevens.
questions.answerZh: 沒有清晰計劃，義工可能最終會亂成一團。
questions.targetMeaning: ● what is happening; ● what they should do; ● who is responsible; ● which plan or instruction to follow; ● how something should be organised.

questions.prompt: The couple changed the guest list and the room at the last minute, leaving their wedding plans confused and disorganised.
questions.promptZh: 這對新人臨時更改賓客名單和場地，令婚禮安排變得混亂。
questions.answer: The last-minute changes left the wedding plans at sixes and sevens.
questions.answerZh: 這些臨時改動令婚禮安排亂成一團。
questions.targetMeaning: ● what is happening; ● what they should do; ● who is responsible; ● which plan or instruction to follow; ● how something should be organised.

questions.prompt: The new staff received an unclear email, so they do not know where to report or what to bring.
